definitions.explanation: The second month of the year and the shortest month. Features Setsubun (節分) and Valentine's Day.

examples.japanese: {二月|にがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧。
{二月|にがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{二月|にがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{降|ふ}ります→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: It snows a lot in February.

examples.japanese: {二月|にがつ}⟦{十四日|じゅうよっか}→十四日：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦バレンタインデー→バレンタインデー：25278_barentaindee⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

{二月|にがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{感|かん}じます→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: February is the shortest month of the year, but it feels long because it's cold.

notes:
{二月|にがつ} is February, the second and shortest month of the year.

FORMATION:
⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ (two) + ⟦{月|がつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧ (month) - literally "month two."

KEY EVENTS IN FEBRUARY:
- ⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧ (February 3): marks the end of winter
- ⟦バレンタインデー→バレンタインデー：25278_barentaindee⟧ (February 14): Valentine's Day

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, women give chocolate to men on Valentine's Day. Men reciprocate on ⟦ホワイトデー→ホワイトデー：25279_howaitodee⟧ (White Day, March 14).

RELATED MONTHS:
- ⟦{一月|いちがつ}→一月：00631_ichigatsu⟧: January
- ⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧: March

NOTE:
February usually has 28 days, or 29 in a ⟦{閏年|うるうどし}→閏年：noentry⟧ (leap year).
